scope: Public web sources that may help locate or corroborate Serock civil-register acts.
warning: Public visibility is not an open training license. Nothing in this inventory is gold or training-eligible merely because it is online.

admission_policy.benchmark: A field is benchmark truth only after a human verifies it against a pinned scan and records a gold-attestation sidecar.
admission_policy.training: Only permitted scan-derived labels made by this project may enter training. JRI-Poland, Geneteka, JewishGen, memorial-institution, and unlicensed user-contributed content remain excluded.
admission_policy.reference: Reference-only sources may identify a year, act type, act number, or candidate spelling for later image verification. They may not populate labels automatically.

sources.title: Akta urodzenia, małżeństwa i śmierci z Serocku
sources.holding_institution: Central Archives for the History of the Jewish People, National Library of Israel

coverage.catalog_note: The catalog describes Hebrew signatures and the years 1813/14 through 1819/20.

sources.value: Confirms that a much earlier Serock manuscript survives, but it cannot seed the current corpus without separately obtained images and permission.

sources.title: Translation of Cyrillic Death & Marriage Records, Serock, Poland
sources.value: Provides four exact act coordinates and candidate identities. Use only to locate the corresponding permitted scans and to define verification targets.

sources.title: Pieniek public family GEDCOM
sources.value: Useful as a discovery map only. Its own source block identifies Jewish Records Indexing - Poland, which is excluded from AKTREADER training.

sources.title: The Book of Serock online translation

coverage.years: community history rather than act-level register coverage

sources.value: Name and community context only. It is not a civil-register transcription and must not be used as label truth.

sources.title: PTG Skanoteka Serock Jewish civil-register scans, collection 0826d
sources.value: Primary image evidence. The annual handwritten indexes and duplicate certificates in annexes create zero-cost weak supervision, but human image attestation is still required for benchmark truth.
sources.acquisition_note: Do not scrape or mirror the viewer. The project already has a permitted local scan reservoir and uses polite, owner-controlled acquisition rules.

discovery_verdict.usable_zero_cost_start: Use the permitted Serock scans already held by the owner. Pair each act with its in-register handwritten annual-index row, repeated name in the closing formula, and any duplicate certificate in the annexes. Treat those pairs as WEAK_REFERENCE until human-attested.
